$comment: The error-detail contract between the backend and the frontend.
The backend answers in English (AGENTS.md) and the frontend localizes the
and fails when a service raises a detail with no entry — so a new error
string can never ship without Arabic copy.
id       stable key, never shown to the user
detail   the exact English detail the backend sends
pattern  a regex for details that vary (interpolated numbers, Pydantic)
sample   a concrete detail the pattern catches (required with pattern)
ar       the Arabic message; null means the English passes through
note     why the English passes through (required when ar is null)
framework  true when the message comes from FastAPI/Pydantic, not our code
Order is priority: the first entry that matches wins, so a broad pattern
must never sit above the specific entries it would shadow.
